extracted.intended_audience: federal agency officials and staff who prepare rules and regulatory analyses, OIRA reviewers, and members of the public who participate in notice-and-comment
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and reference materials for federal regulatory review, regulatory analysis (Circular A-4), agency good guidance practices, submitting rules for OMB/OIRA review, and resources for public participation (e.g., writing effective public comments).

rubrics_metrics.name: RegInfo.gov (Unified Agenda search and EO 12866 meeting requests)
rubrics_metrics.description: RegInfo.gov, where to find Federal regulatory information. The public can use this site to search the Unified Agenda of Regulatory and Deregulatory Actions and Regulatory Plan, as well as current and past OIRA regulatory reviews in accordance with EO 12866. You can also request EO 12866 meetings on this site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains that RegInfo.gov is the public resource to find Unified Agenda and OIRA review records and to request EO 12866 meetings; references an available how-to video about requesting EO 12866 meetings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulations.gov (how to submit effective public comments)
rubrics_metrics.description: Regulations.gov, your one-stop site to comment on Federal regulations. The public can use this site to send their comments electronically to agencies on Federal regulations published for comment in the Federal Register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Points users to Regulations.gov for submitting comments and notes that a video and written guidance on 'how to write an effective public comment' are available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final Bulletin for Agency Good Guidance Practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Final Bulletin for Agency Good Guidance Practices (January 25, 2007).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cited as the principal bulletin on agency good guidance practices; linked along with implementation memoranda (M-07-07, M-07-13).

rubrics_metrics.name: M-07-07 (OMB Bulletin No. 07-02) — Issuance of OMB’s 'Final Bulletin for Agency Good Guidance Practices'
rubrics_metrics.description: M-07-07 (OMB Bulletin No. 07-02), Issuance of OMB’s 'Final Bulletin for Agency Good Guidance Practices' (January 18, 2007).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative memorandum implementing the Final Bulletin; included as operative guidance for agencies on good guidance practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance for Implementing Executive Order 12866
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for Implementing EO 12866 (October 12, 1993).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identified as core guidance for implementing EO 12866 regulatory planning and review requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Circular A-4, 'Regulatory Analysis' (Nov 9, 2023) and related materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Circular A-4, 'Regulatory Analysis' (November 9, 2023) with an Appendix, an Explanation and Response to Public Input, and related materials; effective dates and applicability are specified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies effective date (March 1, 2024 for analyses supporting proposed/interim/direct final rules; Jan 1, 2025 for other final rules) and encourages agencies to follow the Circular earlier where feasible; includes links to FAQs and explanatory documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Circular A-4 (2003) and Circular A-4 Primer / FAQs
rubrics_metrics.description: Circular A-4 (2003) [superseded and rescinded]; Circular A-4, 'Regulatory Impact Analysis: A Primer' (August 15, 2011); Circular A-4 FAQs (February 7, 2011).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical materials and primers to assist agencies in preparing regulatory impact analyses consistent with OMB practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency Checklist: Regulatory Impact Analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Agency Checklist: Regulatory Impact Analysis (October 28, 2010).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical checklist for agencies preparing RIAs to ensure analyses meet expected content and structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of OIRA review correspondence: Return Letters, Prompt Letters, Review Letters
rubrics_metrics.description: Regulatory Review — Concluded Executive Order Reviews; Lists and Statistics; Return Letters; Prompt Letters; Review Letters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies categories of OIRA communications to agencies during regulatory review (return/prompt/review letters) as part of the regulatory review process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission Forms: Request for OMB Review Under EO 12866 (Form OMB 83-R)
rubrics_metrics.description: Request for OMB Review Under Executive Order 12866 (Form OMB 83-R) (Revised December 1997).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural form agencies use to submit rules for OMB review under EO 12866; included in the 'Regulatory Review Submission Forms' list along with CRA submission form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission Forms: Submission of Federal Rules Under the Congressional Review Act
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission of Federal Rules Under the Congressional Review Act (2 pages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form/procedure for providing required information under the Congressional Review Act when agencies submit rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: M-19-14 — Guidance on Compliance with the Congressional Review Act
rubrics_metrics.description: M-19-14, Guidance on Compliance with the Congressional Review Act (April 11, 2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Memorandum providing guidance to agencies on complying with CRA requirements when issuing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: M-07-24 / Principles for Risk Analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: M-07-24, Updated Principles for Risk Analysis (September 19, 2007); Principles for Risk Analysis (January 12, 1995).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principles governing how agencies should conduct risk analysis as part of regulatory analysis and decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: M-21-06 — Guidance for Regulation of Artificial Intelligence Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: M-21-06, Memorandum to the Heads of Executive Departments and Agencies, 'Guidance for Regulation of Artificial Intelligence Applications' (November 17, 2020), and related draft memorandum and Federal Register notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides guidance and solicits public comment on how agencies should approach regulation of AI applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: OIRA policy on machine-readable reports (XML files)
rubrics_metrics.description: OIRA Reports in .XML Format — The information displayed elsewhere on Information and Regulatory Policy webpages is not presented in a format that allows download and analysis by members of the public. In keeping with OIRA’s policy of transparency and accessibility, the following reports are available in a machine-readable format. These files are in XML (Extensible Markup Language)...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: States OIRA's practice to provide certain reports in XML to ensure open access and machine readability; points to PRA and EO 12866 XML files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social Cost of Greenhouse Gases materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Memorandum from the Interagency Working Group on Social Cost of Greenhouse Gases (December 22, 2023); Technical Support Document: Social Cost of Greenhouse Gases for Regulatory Impact Analysis and Other Areas of Policy Decision-Making (February 26, 2021); data files and annual values.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides technical support and data for incorporating social cost of greenhouse gases into regulatory impact analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance and memoranda on openness and electronic dockets / RIN use
rubrics_metrics.description: Increasing Openness in the Rulemaking Process – Improving Electronic Dockets (May 28, 2010); Increasing Openness in the Rulemaking Process – Use of the Regulation Identifier Number (RIN) (April 7, 2010).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance encouraging transparent electronic dockets and consistent use of RINs to improve public access to rulemaking materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarifying Regulatory Requirements: Executive Summaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarifying Regulatory Requirements: Executive Summaries (January 4, 2012).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Materials focused on improving clarity in regulatory requirements, including executive summaries for complicated rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Informing Consumers through Smart Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Informing Consumers through Smart Disclosure (September 8, 2011).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy principles on using disclosure tools to inform consumers as a regulatory tool.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principles for Regulation and Oversight of Emerging Technologies
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles for Regulation and Oversight of Emerging Technologies (March 11, 2011).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on regulatory approaches and principles applicable to emerging technologies.

rubrics_metrics.name: M-11-23 — Export and Trade Promotion, Public Participation, and Rulemaking
rubrics_metrics.description: M-11-23, Export and Trade Promotion, Public Participation, and Rulemaking (May 19, 2011).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Memorandum addressing intersections of export/trade promotion, public participation, and agency rulemaking processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: MOA — Treasury and OMB Review of Tax Regulations Under EO 12866
rubrics_metrics.description: MOA – Treasury and OMB Review of Tax Regulations Under Executive Order 12866 (June 9, 2023).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agreement/memorandum of agreement describing interagency review processes for tax regulations subject to EO 12866.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Calls for the Unified Agenda of Federal Regulatory and Deregulatory Actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Data Call documents for various years (e.g., 2024 Fall and Spring Unified Agenda data calls; numerous prior years listed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural directives and templates instructing agencies how to prepare submissions for the Regulatory Plan and Unified Agenda (i.e., what agencies must report and when).

rubrics_metrics.name: M-00-02 — Guidance for Implementing E.O. 13132 ('Federalism')
rubrics_metrics.description: M-00-02, Guidance for Implementing E.O. 13132, 'Federalism' (October 28, 1999).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance for agencies on considering federalism principles when developing regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Historical/regulatory planning documents and memos (miscellaneous)
rubrics_metrics.description: Various memoranda and historical documents (e.g., Memorandum from John D. Graham on OMB Circular A-4; Memorandum on Benefit-Cost Methods and Lifesaving Rules; Memoranda on Regulations.gov; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collection of historical guidance documents and memoranda that have influenced OIRA/OMB practice on regulatory analysis, public participation, and regulatory review.
